final: SELECT orderslink, avg_reb, avg_ratio, CASE WHEN overall IS NOT NULL THEN avg_ratio / overall END AS rel_ratio FROM (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_ratio, (SELECT AVG(r) FROM (SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS r FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink)) AS overall FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink) ORDER BY rel_ratio IS NULL, rel_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
